ck_declare_ambition_terra_decision = {
	picture = {
		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_realm.dds"
	}
	desc = ck_declare_ambition_terra_decision_desc
	selection_tooltip = ck_declare_ambition_terra_decision_tooltip
	decision_group_type = major
	sort_order = 89
	progress = ck_ambition_declare_bar_terra

	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 0
		duchy = 0
		kingdom = 24
		empire = 12
		hegemony = 12
	}

	is_shown = {
		ck_ambition_possible_terra = yes
		ck_ambition_progress_terra >= ck_ambition_shown_progress
		NOT = { has_character_flag = ck_ambition_terra }
	}

	is_valid = {
		custom_description = {
			text = ck_amb_req_terra
			value = ck_ambition_valid_count_terra
			ck_realm_counties_terra >= ck_ambition_valid_count_terra
		}
		custom_description = {
			text = ck_amb_req_none_other
			ck_has_hegemonic_ambition = no
		}
		custom_description = {
			text = ck_amb_req_no_cooldown
			ck_ambition_on_cooldown = no
		}
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_capable_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
		is_at_war_as_defender = no
	}

	cost = { prestige = ck_ambition_cost_terra }

	effect = {
		ck_ambition_declare_effect = { G = terra NOTIFY = ck_ambition.102 RIVAL = ck_ambition.103 RIVAL_SELF = ck_ambition.104 }
	}

	ai_potential = { always = yes }
	ai_will_do = {
		base = 40
		modifier = { add = 50 has_trait = ambitious }
		modifier = { add = 25 has_trait = arrogant }
		modifier = { add = 15 has_trait = brave }
		modifier = { add = -40 has_trait = content }
		modifier = { add = -25 has_trait = craven }
		modifier = { add = -20 has_trait = humble }
		modifier = { add = 25 ck_ambition_progress_terra >= 75 }
	}
}

	cost = { prestige = ck_ambition_cost_moon }

		ck_ambition_declare_effect = { G = moon NOTIFY = ck_ambition.1102 RIVAL = ck_ambition.1103 RIVAL_SELF = ck_ambition.1104 }
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 40
		modifier = { add = 50 has_trait = ambitious }
		modifier = { add = 25 has_trait = arrogant }
		modifier = { add = 15 has_trait = brave }
		modifier = { add = -40 has_trait = content }

		modifier = { add = -20 has_trait = humble }

	}

	selection_tooltip = ck_abandon_hegemonic_ambition_decision_tooltip
	decision_group_type = major
	sort_order = 88

	ai_check_interval_by_tier = {
		barony = 0
		county = 0
		duchy = 0
		kingdom = 60
		empire = 60
		hegemony = 60
	}

	is_shown = { ck_has_hegemonic_ambition = yes }

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_capable_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
	}

	effect = {
		ck_ambition_end_any_effect = yes
		add_prestige = -150
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = ck_ambition_abandoned_modifier years = 5 }
	}

	ai_potential = { always = yes }
	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
		modifier = { add = 30 has_trait = content }
	}
}
